extDescription.message: Copies your ADP Workforce Now schedule into a Google Calendar it owns. No passwords, no servers, no tracking.

exportDone.message: Downloaded $FILE$ with your schedule ($COUNT$ shifts). Import it into any calendar app.

exportSessionDead.message: Sign in to ADP, then try Export .ics again.

syncCreatedSummary.message: Created ADP Shifts. $CREATED$ created, $UPDATED$ updated, $RESTORED$ restored, $DELETED$ deleted.

syncSummary.message: ADP Shifts: $CREATED$ created, $UPDATED$ updated, $RESTORED$ restored, $DELETED$ deleted.

noPosition.message: Open Calendar in ADP once so the extension can find your work schedule.

needsSignIn.message: ADP needs you to sign in again

sessionDead.message: Sign in to ADP, then try Sync now again.

noSchedule.message: No schedule for this period yet.

positionInvalid.message: Open Calendar in ADP again so the extension can find your work schedule.

shapeDrift.message: ADP changed its data format. Nothing was changed.

adpError.message: ADP could not return the schedule: $DETAIL$.

googleAuth.message: Google access was revoked. Use Sync now to reconnect Google.

calendarMissing.message: The Shift Calendar is missing. Try Sync now again.

conflict.message: Google already has one of these Shifts.

googleError.message: Google Calendar could not be updated.

missingClient.message: Google sign-in is not configured yet.

notDue.message: A Sync is not due yet.

adpSignedInTitle.message: Sign in to Workforce Now in this browser

adpSignedInBody.message: Open ADP Workforce Now and sign in with your work account. This extension never asks for your ADP password. ADP access is confirmed when your Calendar loads.

myScheduleBody.message: Click Calendar in the top-right navigation, then open your work schedule. Keep that page open until your schedule is detected here.

connectGoogleBody.message: Choose the Google account where you want your shifts. ADP Shifts reads your calendar list to reuse its existing calendar, manages only calendars it creates, and reads your email so you can check which account is connected.

connectGoogleFailed.message: Google was not connected. Try again.

firstSyncBody.message: Open the extension popup and start syncing your schedule from today onward. Progress and the result appear in the popup.

onboardingDone.message: Setup is complete. You can change these settings any time.

timeZoneHelp.message: Your browser’s time zone is selected automatically. Choose a different zone if your work schedule uses one. The next Sync uses the selected zone.

timeZoneSaved.message: Time zone saved. It applies on the next Sync.

timeZoneInvalid.message: Choose a valid time zone from the list.

disconnectHelp.message: Forgets the Google token and clears everything this extension stored.

disconnectConfirm.message: Disconnect Google and clear all stored extension data?

disconnected.message: Google was disconnected and stored data was cleared.

disconnectFailed.message: Stored data was cleared. Google did not revoke the token.

lastSync.message: Last successful Sync $WHEN$: $CREATED$ created, $UPDATED$ updated, $RESTORED$ restored, $DELETED$ deleted.

calendarGuide.message: Illustration of the ADP navigation bar, with Calendar highlighted beside Things to Do.

calendarGuideCaption.message: Look for the calendar icon at the top right of ADP. Navigation may vary by employer.

googleSignedOut.message: Google signed out. Connect again to choose another account. Your ADP and time-zone settings are kept.

googleSignOutFailed.message: Signed out on this device. Google could not revoke access; you can also remove ADP Shifts in your Google Account connections.

googleReconnect.message: Reconnect Google to confirm your account email.
